Subject: Pilot extension request + alternative packaging question

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the support during our pilot — the team got useful signal from the model on the product tagging flow. We’re close on the functional bar but need two more weeks of data collection (about +40k tokens/day) to validate batch performance on edge cases.

Before I loop procurement, quick question on packaging: our finance team prefers a single PO rather than multiple small invoices. Would Redwood accept a short extension in exchange for an upfront voucher (usage credits) that consumes against our committed PO?

High-level ask: 2-week extension of the pilot window, + an upfront voucher that will cover the additional tokens. If that’s not workable, we’re open to a time-limited SKU top-up (one-off). Can you outline what options would look like (pricing, any discount, billing flow)?

Also attaching the latest MAP and the usage excerpt I pulled (attached).

Thanks,
— Caroline

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot extension request + alternative packaging question

Hi Caroline — great to hear the pilot is producing signal. Appreciate the clear ask. Below are three practical options we can do quickly; all are intended to avoid multiple micro invoices and to keep your team’s procurement happy.

Option A — Voucher (preferred for procurement)
- One upfront voucher that covers the extra two weeks of estimated usage (~560k tokens total).
- Voucher issued as a single invoice/PO line item; net-30 invoicing on the PO as usual.
- We can offer a 10% credit on the voucher amount given it’s an add-on to an active pilot.

Option B — Time-boxed SKU top-up
- Temporary SKU that increases token cap for two weeks (billed in the month-end invoice).
- No voucher paperwork; just a single invoice line with SKU + quantity.
- Pricing: standard pilot top-up rate (no discount) — simpler operationally.

Option C — Two-week extension with graduated discount
- Extend pilot window by two weeks; we’ll apply a 7% discount on additional tokens above your current baseline.
- Requires a short amendment (one-page SOW) rather than a voucher.

Operational notes:
- If procurement needs a single PO, Option A maps cleanly because we can issue a voucher code and treat the PO as payment for the voucher.
- We’ll need the PO number and billing contact to draft the invoice (Ben can coordinate with your procurement team).

I attached a draft MAP update that shows how the voucher would be reflected and an estimate of token coverage. If one of these lines up, I’ll loop finance and get a draft invoice ready.

Which option would you prefer? Happy to jump on a 20m call if that speeds approval.

Best,
— Priya

Caroline — looping in finance/ops context. A couple of notes from our side:

- If you opt for Option A (voucher), finance prefers a single-line description on the PO: "Novaworks pilot voucher (two-week extension)" + PO number. That minimizes effort to recognize revenue and apply credits.
- We can accommodate a 10% credit on the voucher (as Priya suggested) but need the PO by EOD Friday to lock that pricing.
- For Option C (amendment + discount) we’ll need a signed one-page SOW; legal turnaround is ~2 business days.

If you think procurement needs any sample wording for the PO, I can provide one. Also copying Evelyn to confirm we have capacity in the cluster during the requested two-week window — Evelyn, any concerns with provisioning?
